identification: Mixed petroliana: Golden Fleece 1 lb grease tin (ram over 'Golden Fleece' panel, yellow over blue, 'Contents 1 lb net', blank label panel), worn with scratches and rust, dark rusty top; a taller and a shorter plain glass oil bottle, one with a red plastic pourer and cork, one with a white BP Super MS 20/30 plastic pourer; a loose red BP ISCO plastic pourer; a Goodyear 'Car Type Cured Back' 1 lb tin (made in Australia), rusty with torn label; a dirty Golden Fleece Gear Oil HV90 5 litre plastic container. viewing_check: The Golden Fleece 1 lb tin carries most of the value: check whether its lid is present, how deep the rust on the top and base goes, and whether the yellow label panel is blank or just faded. Check the bottles for chips and cracks at the neck and look for any embossed maker or brand on the glass. I found no outside sale of the Goodyear cured-back patch tin or the plastic HV90 gear oil container.
